full_judgment: 10. Immediately after liberation, the Government of Bangladesh enforced on 26th March, 1972, the Bangladesh (Vesting of Property and Assets) Order, 1972 (PO No.29 of 1972). By this order, all properties situated in East Pakistan that belonged to Pakistan Government became vested in the People's Republic of Bangladesh. Thus all Government properties, including but not limited to Khas land, river, Enemy Properties listed under the 1965 and 1969 Ordinance etc. became vested in Bangladesh. However, each category of land continued to be governed by specific laws relating to each category.
